verdict.rationale: The Department of State documents that filers receive their filing receipt as a PDF and can request plain or certified copies of filed documents as PDF attachments. That gives per-document retrieval of one's own records in an open format. There is no documented bulk or self-service export of everything associated with an entity, and the copies are add-on requested services rather than an export function. missing for 10: bulk export of all entity records, machine-readable structured formats (e.g., CSV/JSON/API), a documented self-service export or offboarding path, independent corroboration.
